svg.title: A map of the SocialVec embedding space
svg.desc: t-SNE projection of 285 popular accounts. Accounts form tight groups by topic and community: Democratic politics, Republican politics, NBA, Soccer, Universities, Pop music, Tech, Space & science.
svg.text: A map of the social space
285 accounts: eight pairs of seed accounts and their nearest neighbours in the 2020 model, projected to 2-D with t-SNE.
